thread:
ana (PM): Proposal: ship a tight Console observability MVP in 2 sprints. Must-haves: 1) per-route cost heatmap + gzipped CSV export; 2) "open-trace" deep-link on p95 spikes; 3) error-regression card with grouped alerts and simple runbook links. Keep GA without historical backfill. Pilot first.
dev (eng): OK. Tech needs: route_id tag in ingress (~1 day), change tokens metric to include tag (~1 day), materialized view for UI (~2 days), CSV endpoint + gzip + pagination (~1 day). Keep tagging behind FF.
ruth (sre): Sampling strategy: dynamic floor + emergency capture. Suggest base 0.25% for high-QPS, scale up on anomaly, and always capture full traces on errors. Add per-deployment override. Also require trace_id surface only when admin toggle enabled.
jo (design): UI: three compact cards. Heatmap: rows=routes, cols=time, click-to-filter. Latency card shows p50/p95 + "Open trace" CTA when spike detected. Error card groups by fingerprint with trend sparkline and quick runbook link. Will deliver mocks Thu.
cam (cs): Pilot asks: Dedicated/Private customers want per-deployment slicing + CSV (timezone aware) and admin-only export switches. Hosted customers mainly want quick trace links for debugging. Add estimated_cost_usd column.
nana (PM): (typo) meant ana above :)
dev (eng): Risk: backfill heavy if we want historical costs. Recommend GA shows data only from ship; provide optional backfill job post-GA. Privacy: exposing trace_id header for hosted has concerns; default off.
ruth (sre): Alerting rules proposal: warn if error_rate >0.008 over 24h, escalate if >0.02. Group by signature (status+message-snippet). Rate-limit notifications per customer to avoid pager storms. For latency, trigger deep capture if p95 grows >40% vs baseline. Example ops config to include in docs:
```yaml
tracing:
  base_sample: 0.0025
  error_capture: true
  per_deployment_override: true
  expose_trace_header: false
  latency_spike_multiplier: 1.4
```
jo (design): Copy for toggles: 'Capture full traces on errors' and 'Enable route-level cost estimates'. Add short modal: 'Estimates are approximate; historical data shown only after backfill job runs.'
cam (cs): I'll recruit two pilots (Customer-Blue, Customer-Maple) this week — need admin toggle and PII opt-out for routes.
deploy-bot: CI green for feature/obs-mini-mvp :white_check_mark:
nana (PM): Action items: @dev implement tagging spike by 2026-04-01, @jo mocks by 2026-03-24, @ruth ops doc + alert rules by 2026-03-25, @cam confirm pilots by 2026-03-26. Prioritization: P1 Dedicated/Private, P2 Hosted. Cut if needed: historical backfill, advanced compare mode.
